name: Benjamin Netanyahu
role: Prime Minister of Israel (2022–present; also 1996–99, 2009–21); ICC arrest warrant active. June 6–7, 2026: IDF strikes on June 6 killed 6+ in Gaza City tent camp (groom among dead) and 7-month-old baby in Hebron; June 7: IDF killed 9 more in Khan Younis + Gaza City as Egypt hosted ceasefire talks. June 4: Confirmed heated call with Trump was real but insisted they agree on 'the main things.' Hamas published 3-year phased disarmament conditions June 7 — rejected by Israel. Cairo talks ongoing but Phase 2 remains deeply stalled. October 2026 elections expected.
quote: We are striking Hamas's commanders one by one, including those personally responsible for the October 7 atrocities. Israel will continue to act against all those who threaten our security.

name: Itamar Ben-Gvir
role: National Security Minister, Israel; Otzma Yehudit party leader. May 26, 2026: France formally imposed entry ban — third NATO state to bar him after Poland (5-year ban, May 21) and Canada. ICC reportedly among 5 new sealed warrants for Israeli officials (May 24). Italy opened criminal investigation into flotilla detention (kidnapping, sexual assault). May 21: posted video of bound/kneeling flotilla activists with Israeli anthem — triggering global diplomatic explosion. Poland, UK, France, Canada, Italy all took punitive diplomatic action. ICC prosecutor applied for sealed arrest warrant (May 17). Faces potential ICC prosecution on multiple counts.
quote: I am not ashamed of the images. These activists came to help Hamas — they deserve what they got.

name: Bezalel Smotrich
role: Finance Minister, Israel; Religious Zionism party leader. June 4, 2026: UN Committee on Palestinian Rights formally condemned his Khan al-Ahmar eviction order as a war crime under international law; OHCHR demanded Israel halt forcible displacement and E1 settlement expansion. May 19: publicly confirmed ICC prosecutor sought arrest warrant — charges include apartheid, forced displacement, persecution, transfer of civilian population; immediately ordered evacuation and demolition of Khan al-Ahmar as defiant response. May 12: declared intent to 'destroy the idea of a Palestinian state.' Most hawkish cabinet member on settlement expansion.
quote: This is a declaration of war against Israel and me personally. We will respond — starting with Khan al-Ahmar.

name: Rabbi Dov Lando
role: Spiritual leader of Degel HaTorah (United Torah Judaism coalition partner); on May 12, 2026 ordered party MKs to support Knesset dissolution after Netanyahu froze the ultra-Orthodox military draft exemption bill
quote: There is no more trust in Netanyahu. The government has broken its obligations to the Torah community. We cannot continue in this coalition.

name: Yoav Gallant
role: Former Defense Minister of Israel (dismissed Nov 2024); ICC arrest warrant issued Nov 2024
quote: We are fighting human animals and we act accordingly. I have ordered a complete siege on Gaza — no electricity, no food, no water, no fuel.

name: Benny Gantz
role: Opposition leader, Israel; National Unity party; Former war cabinet member (resigned Jun 2024)
quote: I left the war cabinet because decisions were being made without a clear post-war strategy — and hostages were not the priority they should be.

name: Isaac Herzog
role: President of Israel (ceremonial head of state)
quote: It is an entire nation out there that is responsible. It is not true this rhetoric about civilians not being aware, not involved.

name: Mahmoud Abbas (Abu Mazen)
role: President, Palestinian Authority; PLO Chairman
quote: We must have a fully independent Palestinian state on the 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital. This is our inalienable right.

name: Mohammad Shtayyeh
role: Former Prime Minister, Palestinian Authority (resigned Feb 2024); replaced by Mohammad Mustafa
quote: Israel is conducting a war of total destruction of the Palestinian people. The international community must act now.

name: Marwan Barghouti
role: Imprisoned Fatah leader; widely seen as most popular Palestinian political figure
quote: Palestinian popular resistance is not terrorism. It is the legitimate response of a people under occupation that the world has refused to liberate.

name: Dr. Ali Sha'ath
role: Head of National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG); technocratic Gaza governor under Trump's Board of Peace plan
quote: Our mandate is the restoration of core public services, the rebuilding of civil institutions, and the stabilization of daily life in Gaza. We answer to no faction — only to the Gazan people.

name: Yahya Sinwar (deceased)
role: Hamas military and political leader; architect of Oct 7 attack; killed by IDF Oct 16, 2024
quote: We have decided to pay the price for freedom and to end the occupation. This is just the beginning.

name: Ismail Haniyeh (deceased)
role: Hamas Political Bureau Chief; killed in Tehran July 31, 2024 in assassination attributed to Israel
quote: We extend our hands for a just peace. But our hands will remain on the trigger as long as there is occupation.

name: Mohammed Deif (deceased)
role: Hamas military commander (Qassam Brigades); killed Aug 2024; ICC warrant cancelled Feb 2025
quote: This is the day of the greatest battle to end the last occupation on earth. We have decided to put an end to all crimes.

name: Khaled Meshaal
role: Hamas Political Bureau; based in Qatar; led Hamas in exile during 2007–2017
quote: We in Hamas do not fight the Jews because they are Jews. We fight the occupiers because they are occupiers.

name: António Guterres
role: UN Secretary-General
quote: The ceasefire offers hope, but humanitarian conditions in Gaza remain catastrophic. Reconstruction will take decades. The international community cannot turn away now.

name: Francesca Albanese
role: UN Special Rapporteur on the Situation of Human Rights in the Palestinian Territories
quote: Israel has outsourced coercion to the settlers, and Israel is advancing violently the ethnic cleansing of Palestine through the settlers. [The situation is] incredibly and utterly shameful.

name: Volker Türk
role: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights; issued Mar 2026 report on West Bank settlement expansion
quote: Israel must immediately and completely cease and reverse the establishment and expansion of settlements, evacuate all settlers, and end the occupation of Palestinian territory.

name: Karim Khan
role: ICC Prosecutor; sought arrest warrants for Netanyahu, Gallant; on indefinite leave since May 2025 after US sanctions
quote: We cannot have a world where the laws of war that protect civilians, hospitals, and aid workers apply to some but not others.

name: Cyril Ramaphosa
role: President of South Africa; his government filed the ICJ genocide case; Israel submitted counter-memorial Mar 14, 2026
quote: South Africa knows what it looks like when a government decides that a people are less than human. We have seen genocide before. We see it now in Gaza.

name: Joe Biden
role: US President (2021–Jan 2025); staunch Israel supporter; later pressured Israel on Gaza humanitarian crisis
quote: Israel has a right to defend itself against Hamas terrorism. We will stand with Israel. But we also need a humanitarian pause to get more aid in.

name: Donald Trump
role: US President (2025–present); brokered Oct 2025 ceasefire; chairs 'Board of Peace' for Gaza reconstruction. June 2–4, 2026: tense exchange with Netanyahu over planned Hezbollah strike in Beirut ('Don't') — Netanyahu confirmed June 4 they agree on 'main things.' Phase 2 Gaza talks stalled; Nickolay Mladenov (Board of Peace envoy) postponed talks June 3. May 13–15: Gulf tour (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE) without visiting Israel. Iran war consuming US diplomatic bandwidth — only 0.5% of Gaza rubble cleared despite $10B reconstruction commitment.
quote: Twenty years is enough — a lot can happen in twenty years. And as for Gaza, it will become the most beautiful place on earth — a freedom zone. We are going to make the Middle East prosperous again.

name: Philippe Lazzarini
role: Commissioner-General, UNRWA; agency banned from Israeli territory Jan 2025; now operating with 6 clinics in Gaza
quote: More than 200 of our colleagues have been killed. Our premises have been bombed. We are struggling to keep the humanitarian operation alive in Gaza.

name: Kaja Kallas
role: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy (2024–present); led the unanimous EU vote on May 11, 2026 sanctioning violent Israeli settlers and Hamas leaders — first such EU settler sanctions in 21 months
quote: The EU expects to approve sanctions on extremist Israeli settlers. We stand united against settler violence that is destabilizing the West Bank and against Hamas leaders who continue to obstruct peace.

name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
role: President of Turkey; severed trade with Israel; called Netanyahu 'Hitler of our time'
quote: Netanyahu — who has turned Gaza into a death camp — is no different than Hitler. He will face justice before international courts.

name: Mohammed bin Salman
role: Saudi Crown Prince; normalization talks with Israel paused after Oct 7; key regional actor
quote: Normalization with Israel without a credible pathway to a Palestinian state is not something Saudi Arabia can accept.

name: Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir
role: IDF Chief of Staff (2025–present); warned of five-front sustainability crisis; May 15, 2026: observed 'Sulfur and Fire' snap readiness drill on Jordanian border with 96th and 80th regional divisions, citing Oct 7 as proof of need for constant border readiness
quote: The main lesson of October 7 is the need for a high and constant level of readiness for a surprise attack on our borders. Every division, every unit must be ready at zero warning.

name: Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth
role: IDF Central Command Chief (head of West Bank military administration); publicly called settler violence 'Jewish terror' and warned of Palestinian uprising (May 1, 2026)
quote: Settler violence against Palestinians is Jewish terror. It risks triggering a Palestinian uprising that would threaten the security of every Israeli. The IDF cannot stand by while 59 West Bank communities are depopulated — this is an existential threat to the state.

name: Naftali Bennett
role: Former Prime Minister of Israel (2021–2022); leader of Hayamin Hehadash party; announced merger with Yair Lapid's Yesh Atid (April–May 2026) ahead of expected October 2026 elections
quote: The center-right must unite to restore responsible governance to Israel. We cannot allow the far right to define what Israel is — we are a democratic state with rule of law.

name: Yariv Levin
role: Justice Minister of Israel; architect of 2023 judicial overhaul; on May 7, 2026 threatened to let the Supreme Court 'go extinct' if sitting justices block his judicial appointments
quote: The Supreme Court has become a radical elite unaccountable to the people of Israel. If the justices continue to block legitimate government appointments, they will face the consequences.

name: Khalil Al-Hayya
role: Senior Hamas Political Bureau official; chief Hamas negotiator in disarmament talks with the Board of Peace; based in Doha, Qatar; six+ family members harmed by Israeli strikes since the Oct 2025 ceasefire — son killed May 8, 2026; son Azzam (23) killed May 13, 2026 in IDF Shejaiya strike alongside Hamas commander Hamza Sharbasi
quote: Hamas will never accept disarmament as a precondition for peace. Israel assassinates our families to break our will — but it only strengthens our resolve. What is being demanded of us is unconditional surrender, not a ceasefire.
